hooks.text: 战中即时切换队员，用三消信号触发闪避、格挡与必杀连段
hooks.excerpt: Immerse yourself in fluid, high-speed combat with real-time 3D control. Seamlessly switch between squad members mid-fight, master unique abilities, and chain together dazzling combos. Utilize an intuitive 3-Ping skill system to parry, dodge, and unleash devastating Signature Moves.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 数百章视觉小说叙事深入毁灭后的赛博朋克地球
hooks.excerpt: Through rich visual-novel storytelling spanning hundreds of chapters, discover a hauntingly beautiful universe filled with hidden wonders—and even darker secrets waiting to be uncovered.

hooks.text: 人类意识装入机械躯体，组成全3D后人类战斗兵器阵容
hooks.excerpt: Mankind's last hope lies in the Constructs—human consciousness housed in advanced mechanical bodies. Recruit and command a diverse roster of these living weapons, each meticulously designed and animated in full 3D, to face off against hundreds of enemy variants.
